answer: Written in a first-principles reasoning, builds from axioms register, it stays short. The design leans on automated market makers with concentrated liquidity. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the haven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the zephyr of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the cedar re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
